e_ayatulkursi.title: Ayatul Kursi (The Verse of the Throne)
e_ayatulkursi.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ ۬ۚ لَا تَاۡخُذُهٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ ؕ لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ ؕ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَهٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِهٖ ؕ یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡهِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ ۚ وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِیُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ ۚ وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُهٗ حِفۡظُهُمَا ۚ وَ هُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
e_ayatulkursi.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā ta'khudhuhu sinatuw-walā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, man dhāl-ladhī yashfa'u 'indahu illā bi'idhnih, ya'lamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum, walā yuḥīṭūna bishay'im-min 'ilmihī illā bimā shā', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, walā ya'ūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wahuwal-'aliyyul-'aẓīm.
e_ayatulkursi.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
e_ayatulkursi.benefit: Whoever recites it morning and evening will be protected throughout the day and night from the harm of jinn. Whoever recites it before sleeping, no devil will approach him. Whoever recites it after every obligatory prayer, nothing will stand between him and Paradise except death.
e_ayatulkursi.reference: Surah Al-Baqarah: 255. Al-Hakim, 2064; Al-Bukhari, 2311; An-Nasa'i, As-Sunanul Kubra.

e_ikhlas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas (The Sincerity) — 1st of the Three Quls
e_ikhlas.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ۔ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ۔ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ۔ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
e_ikhlas.transliteration: Qul huwal-lāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid walam yūlad. Walam yakul-lahu kufuwan aḥad.
e_ikhlas.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor was He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.
e_ikhlas.benefit: Reciting this surah once equals the reward of reciting one-third of the Quran. Reciting all three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) will be sufficient protection against every harm.

e_falaq.title: Surah Al-Falaq (The Daybreak) — 2nd of the Three Quls
e_falaq.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ۔ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
e_falaq.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wamin sharrin-naffāthāti fil-'uqad. Wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
e_falaq.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
e_falaq.benefit: Reciting all three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) will be sufficient protection against every harm.

e_nas.title: Surah An-Nas (Mankind) — 3rd of the Three Quls
e_nas.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ۔ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ۔ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ۔ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ۔ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ۔ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
e_nas.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. Ilāhin-nās. Min sharril-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wan-nās.
e_nas.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind — from among the jinn and mankind.
e_nas.benefit: Reciting all three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) will be sufficient protection against every harm.

e_hasbiyallah.title: Hasbiyallah (Allah is Sufficient for Me)
e_hasbiyallah.arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
e_hasbiyallah.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbul-'arshil-'aẓīm.
e_hasbiyallah.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
e_hasbiyallah.benefit: Whoever says this 7 times in the morning and 7 times in the evening, Allah will be sufficient for him against all the worries and anxieties of this world and the Hereafter.
e_hasbiyallah.reference: Surah At-Tawbah: 129. Abu Dawud, 5081; Ibn As-Sunni, 71.

e_sayyidul_istighfar.title: Sayyidul Istigfaar (The Master Supplication for Forgiveness)
e_sayyidul_istighfar.arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّىْ لآ إِلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِىْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوْءُ بِذَنْبِىْ فَاغْفِرْ لِىْ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَيَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
e_sayyidul_istighfar.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī, lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā 'abduk, wa anā 'alā 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-taṭa't. A'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana't, abū'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abū'u bidhambī, faghfir lī fa'innahū lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
e_sayyidul_istighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am upon Your covenant and promise to the best of my ability. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for indeed no one forgives sins except You.
e_sayyidul_istighfar.benefit: Whoever recites this with firm conviction in the morning or evening, and dies that same day or night, will certainly enter Paradise.

e_bismillah_la_yadurr.title: Bismillah Du'a (Protection Supplication)
e_bismillah_la_yadurr.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
e_bismillah_la_yadurr.transliteration: Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-arḍi walā fis-samā', wahuwaṣ-samī'ul-'alīm.
e_bismillah_la_yadurr.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing on earth or in the sky can cause harm. And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
e_bismillah_la_yadurr.benefit: Whoever says this 3 times each morning and evening, nothing will harm him.

e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.title: La Ilaha Illallah (Declaration of Tawhid)
e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.arabicText: لآ إِلهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الُحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-ḥamd, wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.benefit: Whoever says this 10 times morning and evening will receive 10 good deeds, have 10 sins forgiven, be raised 10 degrees in rank, earn the reward of freeing 4 slaves, and be protected from Satan.
e_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.reference: Ibn Hibban, 2023; Abu Dawud, 5077; Al-Bukhari, 6403; Muslim, 2691.

e_allahumma_bika_amsayna.title: Allahumma Bika Amsayna (Evening Prayer)
e_allahumma_bika_amsayna.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرِ
e_allahumma_bika_amsayna.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā, wabika aṣbaḥnā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa'ilaykal-maṣīr.
e_allahumma_bika_amsayna.translation: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the evening, and by Your grace we reach the morning. By Your mercy we live, and by Your will we die; and to You is the final return.
e_allahumma_bika_amsayna.benefit: This supplication acknowledges full dependence on Allah from evening to morning, in life and in death.

e_amsayna_ala_fitrah.title: Amsayna ala Fitratil Islam (Evening Affirmation of Faith)
e_amsayna_ala_fitrah.arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِيْنِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
e_amsayna_ala_fitrah.transliteration: Amsaynā 'alā fiṭratil-islām, wa'alā kalimatil-ikhlāṣ, wa'alā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wasallam, wa'alā millati abīnā ibrāhīma ḥanīfam-muslimaw-wamā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
e_amsayna_ala_fitrah.translation: We have reached the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright and a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
e_amsayna_ala_fitrah.benefit: Reaffirming the Islamic faith at the close of each day.

e_allahumma_fatir.title: Allahumma Fatiras Samawati (Creator of the Heavens)
e_allahumma_fatir.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
e_allahumma_fatir.transliteration: Allāhumma fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, 'ālamal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, lā ilāha illā ant, rabba kulli shay'in wamalīkah. A'ūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wamin sharrish-shayṭāni washirakihi, wa'an aqtarifa 'alā nafsī sū'an, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim.
e_allahumma_fatir.translation: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is no deity except You, Lord and Sovereign of all things. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Satan and his traps, and from committing wrong against myself or bringing it upon any Muslim.
e_allahumma_fatir.benefit: Protection from the whispers and traps of the soul and Satan.

e_afwa_wal_afiyah.title: Allahumma Inni As'alukal Afwa (Prayer for Pardon and Well-being)
e_afwa_wal_afiyah.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
e_afwa_wal_afiyah.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-'afwa wal-'āfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as'alukal-'afwa wal-'āfiyata fī dīnī wadunyāy, wa'ahlī wamālī. Allāhummastir 'awrātī, wa'āmin raw'ātī. Allāhummaḥfaẓnī mim-bayni yadayy, wamin khalfī, wa'an yamīnī, wa'an shimālī, wamin fawqī. Wa'ūdhu bi'aẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
e_afwa_wal_afiyah.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being unexpectedly destroyed from beneath me.
e_afwa_wal_afiyah.benefit: A comprehensive supplication seeking Allah's protection from all directions.

e_allahumma_afini.title: Allahumma Afini fi Badani (Prayer for Health)
e_allahumma_afini.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
e_allahumma_afini.transliteration: Allāhumma 'āfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma 'āfinī fī sam'ī, Allāhumma 'āfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-kufri, wal-faqr, Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā ant.
e_allahumma_afini.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no deity except You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity except You.
e_allahumma_afini.benefit: Protection for the body, hearing, and sight, and seeking refuge from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave.

e_amsayna_wal_mulku.title: Amsayna wa Amsal Mulku (Evening Prayer to Begin the Night)
e_amsayna_wal_mulku.arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
e_amsayna_wal_mulku.transliteration: Amsaynā wa'amsal-mulku lillāh, walḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-ḥamd wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr. Rabbi as'aluka khayra mā fī hādhihil-laylati wa khayra mā ba'dahā. Wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhal-yawmi washarri mā ba'dahā. Rabbi a'ūdhu bika minal-kasal, wasū'il-kibar. Rabbi a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābin fin-nāri wa'adhābin fil-qabr.
e_amsayna_wal_mulku.translation: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah; all praise is for Allah. There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
e_amsayna_wal_mulku.benefit: A comprehensive evening supplication acknowledging Allah's sovereignty, seeking the good of the night, and seeking protection from laziness, old age, Hellfire, and the punishment of the grave.

e_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.title: Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi (Glory and Praise of Allah)
e_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His.
e_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.benefit: Whoever says this 100 times morning and evening will have no one on the Day of Resurrection who has brought more reward than him, except one who said the same or more. Even if his sins were as much as the foam of the sea, they would be forgiven.

e_allahumma_inni_amsaytu.title: Allahumma Inni Amsaytu (Evening Witness of Faith)
e_allahumma_inni_amsaytu.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
e_allahumma_inni_amsaytu.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka wa'ushhidu ḥamalata 'arshika, wamalā'ikataka wajamī'a khalqik, annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa'anna muḥammadan 'abduka warasūluk.
e_allahumma_inni_amsaytu.translation: O Allah, I have reached the evening and I call You to witness, and I call the bearers of Your Throne to witness, and Your angels and all of Your creation to witness, that You are Allah, there is no deity except You alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
e_allahumma_inni_amsaytu.benefit: Whoever recites this 4 times in the evening, Allah will free one-quarter of him from the Hellfire.

e_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum (The Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining)
e_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.arabicText: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ ، أَصْلِحُ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
e_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu biraḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullahu, walā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'ayn.
e_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.translation: O Ever-Living! O Self-Sustaining! By Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
e_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.benefit: A supplication seeking Allah's help and guidance in all affairs of life.

e_allahumma_ma_amsa.title: Allahumma ma Amsa bi (Evening Acknowledgement of Blessings)
e_allahumma_ma_amsa.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
e_allahumma_ma_amsa.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min ni'matin aw bi'aḥadim-min khalqika faminka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, falakal-ḥamdu walakash-shukr.
e_allahumma_ma_amsa.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation has reached this evening, it is from You alone, with no partner. So to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all gratitude.
e_allahumma_ma_amsa.benefit: Whoever says this in the evening has fulfilled the gratitude due to Allah for that day.

e_audhu_bikalimatillah.title: A'udhu Bikalimatillah (Seeking Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words)
e_audhu_bikalimatillah.arabicText: اعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
e_audhu_bikalimatillah.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimātil-lāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
e_audhu_bikalimatillah.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
e_audhu_bikalimatillah.benefit: Whoever says this 3 times in the evening will not be harmed by any venomous creature that night.

e_radhitu_billah.title: Radhitu Billahi Rabba (Declaration of Contentment)
e_radhitu_billah.arabicText: رَضِيْتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
e_radhitu_billah.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabbā, wabil-islāmi dīnā, wabi-muḥammadin nabiyyā.
e_radhitu_billah.translation: I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my Prophet.
e_radhitu_billah.benefit: Whoever says this 3 times morning and evening earns the right to Allah's pleasure on the Day of Resurrection.

e_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.title: Allahumma Ajirni minan-Nar (Protection from Hellfire)
e_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.
e_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.benefit: Whoever says this 7 times after Fajr and Maghrib before speaking to anyone, Allah will protect him from the Hellfire.

e_subhanallah.title: Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah)
e_subhanallah.benefit: Better than donating 100 camels in the way of Allah.
e_subhanallah.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihut-Targhib, 658; An-Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

e_alhamdulillah.title: Alhamdulillah (All Praise is for Allah)
e_alhamdulillah.benefit: Better than donating 100 horses with their riders for battle in the way of Allah.
e_alhamdulillah.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihut-Targhib, 658; An-Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

e_allahu_akbar.title: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest)
e_allahu_akbar.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihut-Targhib, 658; An-Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

e_evening_prayer_good_night.title: Evening Prayer for the Good of the Night
e_evening_prayer_good_night.arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
e_evening_prayer_good_night.transliteration: Amsaynā wa'amsal-mulku lillāhi rabbil-'ālamīn. Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādhihil-laylati fatḥahā wanaṣrahā wanūrahā wabarakatahā wahudāhā. Wa'ūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā washarri mā ba'dahā.
e_evening_prayer_good_night.translation: We have reached the evening, and the dominion has also reached the evening belonging to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what comes after it.
e_evening_prayer_good_night.benefit: Through this supplication, the believing servant asks Allah at the start of the night for five precious gifts — this night's good, victory, light, blessings, and guidance — and seeks protection from every harm of the night and thereafter.

e_astaghfirullah.title: Daily Istighfar (Seeking Forgiveness)
e_astaghfirullah.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance.
e_astaghfirullah.benefit: Through this, sins are forgiven and closeness to Allah is attained.

e_salawat_alan_nabi.title: Salawat on the Prophet (peace be upon him)
e_salawat_alan_nabi.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
e_salawat_alan_nabi.translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
e_salawat_alan_nabi.benefit: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever sends salawat upon me 10 times in the morning and 10 times in the evening will be blessed with my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.'
